review_reference: Owner decision of 2026-11-03 (D-Eminence): the demo patients' profiles must reach 100%; Adaeze (HID-ZDEMAAA2) and Chinedu (HID-ZDEMAAA3) get the phone and NIN with clearly fictional values the real NIN service can never match, through a reviewed seal change following the 0102 pattern.
evidence: 0119 (sealed demo profiles complete), owner decision of 2026-11-03 by D-Eminence: the demo patients' profiles must reach 100%; unsigned until the owner signs. Backward compatible: no table, column, index, constraint, policy or trigger changes. It adds two functions in schema identity, owned by the applier: identity.demo_profile_phone_allowed(text,uuid,text,character) (SECURITY DEFINER, EXECUTE for hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime only) and identity.demo_profile_install() (SECURITY DEFINER, granted to no role), both revoked from PUBLIC in the file and in runtime-grants.sql. It replaces one body, 0098's G5 identity.patient_contact_changes_sealed_demo() (CREATE OR REPLACE; trigger, owner, ACL, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and error code kept), after an md5 precondition on its exact 0098 text and on every body it relies on. WHAT CHANGES. A sealed demo patient's phone change is still refused (22023) unless Identity asked the new check in the same transaction and it admitted that patient's own fictional number (Adaeze +447700900102, Chinedu +447700900103, the UK drama range) with the change's HMAC; an Identity image that never asks it (every image before this release) still has every demo phone refused, so old images keep working for every real patient. On Amazon RDS only (rds_superuser present, as 0098 and 0102) the seed gives Adaeze and Chinedu a verified nin identifier through a resolved registration case at Demo Hospital, provider and source hid-sealed-demo, with no NIN stored (a lookup value that is not an HMAC under Identity's key, a plain-text marker, hint ****0000); assurance stays CONTACT_VERIFIED; no verification_evidence, authoritative profile, nin_hash or QoreID quota row; G6 unchanged. The seed refuses with 55000 and nothing applied when the demo is not as 0098 and 0102 left it (SEALED_DEMO_PROFILE_NOT_DEMO, _PATIENT_NOT_READY, _ROLE_MISSING, _ID_TAKEN); a patient who already has a NIN identifier is skipped. It does not require the photo or an emergency contact (the owner adds them in the app); the owner runs the header's read-only query before signing. ORDER: 0119 before the identity-api image whose PatientContactChangeService.changePhone asks identity.demo_profile_phone_allowed (an image that asks it before 0119 exists fails every phone change); after both, the owner types the two numbers on the demo profile pages. Numbers 0104-0118 belong to other unreleased work and are not on this branch; 0119 uses none of their objects, and the ledger and components entries must be re-based when they land; the release contract's contiguous-prefix check fails on this branch until then. PROOF on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 (private cluster, synthetic data only): upgrade of a 0001-0103 database by the runner as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator (plan 1 pending, dry run rolled back, apply, then 0 pending, and the file run again answers 0119: already applied); fresh install of all 105 files; the same upgrade and fresh install with a superuser owner; every database suite (77 and the new sealed-demo-profile suite) green on the superuser-owned fresh and upgraded databases (78 of 78 each), and 76 of 78 on the NOSUPERUSER-owned ones, where schema and ocr-worker-lease fail identically on the 0103 baseline without 0119; the staging schema upgrade rehearsal passed (baseline 104, integrated 105, declared 0119); with the role rds_superuser present on a 0103 database in the demo state 0098 and 0102 leave, the runner applied 0119 and seeded 2 cases, 2 identifiers and 5 audit rows, and on the same state with Adaeze inactive it refused SEALED_DEMO_PROFILE_PATIENT_NOT_READY with nothing applied; 7 of 7 mutants killed (G5 without the HMAC match, G5 matching the HMAC only, G5 admitting any recorded value, the check without the patient pairing, the check without the HMAC format, a seed setting NIN_VERIFIED, a seed without its idempotence check); identity-api typecheck and jest; migration ledger verifier.
